argocd.description: Track Helm chart pins inside ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet manifests (e.g. kube-prometheus-stack in argocd/*/apps.yaml). The argocd manager ships disabled — it has no default file patterns — so this block is what makes those pins visible at all.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates for container images. ignoreTests: this repo has no CI checks, and without it Renovate waits forever for statuses that never arrive (nothing auto-merged from April to October 2026).
Never auto-merge a Helm chart bump — charts carry CRDs and values-schema changes, and prod runs with skipCrds: true so CRDs are applied by hand
Pin latest tags to digests for reproducibility
Nextcloud only supports upgrading one major version at a time and migrates its DB on every bump. Never auto-merge it, and raise one PR per major so 35 -> 36 -> 37 can't be skipped.
linuxserver tags embed a build hash (1.43.5.11079-b3b13e506-ls330); compare on the numeric parts only.
Apps that migrate their own database on upgrade: never auto-merge, not even patches or digests (Open WebUI tracks :main, so every update is a digest bump).
Block major upgrades for stateful services (require manual DB migration)
